input: Look into community land trust housing options

gold.taskTitle: Research Community Land Trust Housing Options
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to explore community land trust housing as a potential housing option for themselves.

questions.title: Which city or region are you focused on?
questions.description: Identify the geographic area where the user wants to find CLT housing.

questions.title: Are you looking to buy or rent through a CLT?
questions.description: Determine whether the user is interested in homeownership or rental housing through a community land trust.

questions.title: What is your approximate household income range?
questions.description: Understand the user's income level to assess CLT eligibility and affordability options.

questions.title: Is this for yourself, your family, or someone else?
questions.description: Clarify who the intended occupant of the CLT housing would be.

questions.title: How soon do you need to find housing?
questions.description: Establish the user's timeline or urgency for securing a CLT home.

questions.title: Have you had any prior contact with a CLT organization?
questions.description: Find out if the user is starting from scratch or already has some familiarity or connection with a CLT.

questions.title: What is your biggest concern about CLT housing specifically?
questions.description: Identify the user's primary hesitation or knowledge gap, such as resale restrictions, eligibility, or availability.
